displayName: PMIC Pharma Safety and Approval Signals
description: Scored drug-market and company safety briefs from openFDA: recalls (all and Class I), adverse event reports, label changes, and NDA/BLA and generic approvals for the US drug market, plus per-company recall and approval activity for Pfizer, Eli Lilly and Johnson & Johnson. Each brief is a 0-100 score with label, trend, drivers, risk flags, confidence and openFDA citations. POST /v1/brief with a small JSON body for one scored, cited brief; POST /v1/overview for all of them at once. Results vary as public data updates (5-minute cache). Research signal, not investment advice. Pay per request in USDC; no account, no API key.

inputSchema.description: Body for POST /v1/brief (other routes take similar small bodies).

outputSchema.description: {service, vertical, title, status, score (0-100), label, trend, trend_basis, summary, drivers[], risk_flags[], confidence{score,label}, coverage, inputs[], watch[], citations[{url}], method}. Errors return a JSON object with an error field (HTTP 400).

responseSummary.note: Fill from a live MainNet capture.
